name: Atmospheric Height Gradient
aliases: Atmospheric Height Gradient — Cloud Type Vertical Profile
definition: Defines the vertical density gradient profile for cloud layers based on cloud type (Stratus, Cumulus, Cumulonimbus). It creates a bell-shaped or plateau-shaped density distribution relative to atmosphere thickness.
summary: Atmospheric Height Gradient defines vertical density profiles for volumetric clouds based on type, providing analytic shape functions rather than integration steps or spatial noise.
